notes:
Summary: HarborLight builds a knowledge-base RAG layer for its SaaS helpdesk product. Primary pattern: vector candidate retrieval (dense) -> light cross-encoder reranker for top-20. They are evaluating Redwood hosted API for embeddings + reranking to hit high QPS while controlling per-query cost.

Recent context / asks:
- Customer: mid-market SaaS (helpdesk), ~2M indexed docs (KB articles + transcripts + config docs). Wants sub-200ms median end-to-end response for search, under 150ms for embedding+retrieval portion; reranker can add tail latency but should keep P95 < 400ms.
- QPS target: baseline 300 sustained, spike to 700 QPS during peak support hours. Cost sensitivity: want production cost estimate and knobs to reduce unit cost (batching, caching, quantization).
- Model preferences: prefer open dense-encoder (sentence-transformers) for embeddings; considering a distilled cross-encoder reranker (smaller cross-attention) for top-20. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization and batching.
- Data flow: ingestion pipeline pushes nightly incremental index (approx +20k docs/day). Need predictable cold-start indexing SLA and fast incremental refresh (minutes-level for urgent docs).
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML + SCIM for enterprise customers, audit logs retention 1 year. No air-gapped requirement; public cloud acceptable.

POC plan so far (agreed on call):
- Phase 1: small-scale functional test (10k docs) to validate reranker logic and quality metrics (MRR, NDCG). Owner: SE (Daniel).
- Phase 2: high-QPS performance run on hosted API (48h) at 300->700 QPS; measure latency distribution, token cost, and egress. Owner: Redwood performance team + HarborLight ops.
- Phase 3: cost model and rollout plan incl. caching, batch sizing, and potential Dedicated if hosted can't meet latency/cost SLOs.

Recent activity log (shorthand):
- 2025-02-12: initial discovery call (ff_20250212_0915). noted indexing scale ~2M, priority is cost per live query.
- 2025-02-25: demo of hosted embeddings + sample reranker; HarborLight liked top-k flow but worried about P95. action: share perf profiles + quantization options. (gthread-GL-4521)
- 2025-03-01: architecture review + planning call (ff_20250301_1123). agreed POC scope and Redwood to provide stress scripts.
- 2025-03-02: submission of data access checklist and SOC2 attestation link. waiting SSO test window. (RWD-1123 open for infra setup)

Quotes / paraphrases from HarborLight team:
- "We can tolerate a small reranker latency increase if the search quality jump is material — but cost has to stay predictable."
- "Peak QPS is the real constraint; we need a path to 700 QPS without 10x cost explosion."

Risks & considerations:
- Neural cross-encoder reranking on top-20 at 700 QPS could blow cost unless batching + quantization applied or reranker moved to a smaller distilled model. Consider hybrid fallback: lexical first-pass then rerank only when confidence low.
- Indexing/backfill: 2M docs initial reindex will need throttled ingestion; confirm rate limits and S3-based snapshot approach.
- SSO/SCIM automation for internal staff provisioning is timeboxed to next engineering sprint (mid-March).

Attachments / artifacts referenced:
- HarborLight POC spec: drive://harborlight/prod-rag-poc-specs.pdf
- Pricing draft v2: drive://redwood/proposals/harborlight-hosted-pricing-v2.xlsx
- Open ticket to infra: RWD-1123 (hosted API keys + perf tooling)

Next immediate step: schedule Redwood perf team to run 48h hosted stress test week of 2025-03-10. Need HarborLight to grant API data access and enable SSO test account.
